{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B values: divide biomarker_final by 10 (since 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL)
df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Now, check the structure
print(f"Final dataset shape: {df.shape}")
print(f"Unique patients: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Arm distribution: \n{df['arm'].value_counts()}")
print(f"Severity distribution: \n{df['severity'].value_counts()}")
print(f"Responded: \n{df['responded'].value_counts()}")"}
